description: This file implements the SocketPort class, which manages socket operations including creation, configuration, connection, listening, accepting, reading, writing, and multicast group management. It includes platform-specific code for Windows, POSIX, Linux, and Apple systems, and handles socket initialization, buffer management, and event handling within the WPEFramework Core namespace.

classes.name: WinSocketInitializer
classes.description: Handles Windows socket library initialization and extension function retrieval for WSARecvMsg.

methods.name: ReceiveFrom
methods.description: Receives data from a socket, extracting interface index information for IPv4 and IPv6 packets, platform-specific implementation.

methods.name: DestroySocket
methods.description: Closes and invalidates a socket handle, platform-specific.

methods.name: SetNonBlocking
methods.description: Sets a socket to non-blocking mode, platform-specific.

methods.name: ConstructSocket
methods.description: Creates and configures a socket based on NodeId and interface parameters, platform-specific.
